gizmo.title: Jerin dubawa mai ɗigo
gizmo.description: Jerin akwatunan dubawa. Masu karatu suna yi wa abubuwa alama kuma ana tuna ci gabansu a na'urarsu.

configure.title: Take
configure.description: Sunan jerin. Ana karanta shi da babbar murya a matsayin lakabin rukunin akwatunan dubawa.

configure.title: Abubuwa
configure.description: Kowane abu akwatin dubawa ne. Masu karatu ba za su iya canza abubuwan da aka duba ko aka kashe ba.

configure.title: Mai lamba
configure.description: Nuna jeri mai lamba maimakon mai ɗigo.

configure.title: Matsayi
configure.description: Yana canza launuka don su dace da stop-note.

developer.title: Id na ajiya
developer.description: Id na musamman da ake amfani da shi don tuna ci gaban mai karatu a na'urarsa. Ana samar da shi kai tsaye; canza shi kawai don raba ci gaba tsakanin jeri ko don sake farawa.
